Based on the Lars von Trier miniseries "The Kingdom", the series revolves around the medical staff of a haunted teaching hospital.The Kingdom (Danish title: Riget) is an eight-episode Danish television mini-series, created by Lars von Trier in 1994, and co-directed by Lars von Trier and Morten Arnfred.
